notes.title: Steam Deck minor fixes
notes.content:
This update focuses on improving the experience when playing on a Steam Deck.

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed Cave screen resolution
[*]Fixed mouse behaviour on the Cave
[*]Improved mouse behaviour in the menu
[*]Added joystick support for all menu interactions
[/list]

That's all for now, thank you for everything!

tags.feature: -Added joystick support for all menu interactions

notes.title: Ultrawide Support
notes.content:
Added support for ultrawide resolutions. Has been tested in a 21:9 monitor, 32:9 should work but has not been tested yet.
If you find any issues make sure to report them so I can fix them ASAP!

notes.title: 2 UP!
notes.content:
Added an extra life to the game (you can now revive twice per run).

Also fixed a minor display bug in the food indicator of the cave.
